# bestagent.dev

> Independent, hands-on reviews of AI coding agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and GitHub Copilot — plus the instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md), usage limits, pricing, and workflows around them. Written by working engineers; every price and factual claim is verified against primary sources and dated.
